timeout_reason: Additional wall-clock headroom after the unchanged depth-12 serialized workload exceeded 600 seconds during backend integration validation. Solver, depth, assertions, assumptions, covers and mutation requirements are unchanged.
assumptions: Reset is asserted at the initial sampled edge; subsequent reset, recovery, requests, register addresses, and watched indices are unconstrained.
environment: At most one instruction is active. Allocation requires the independent monitor to be idle, without assuming DUT readiness.
Writeback names the captured live destination once; nonzero destinations commit only after writeback. Zero-destination instructions require no writeback.
Commit carries the allocation's original rename entry. Reset/recovery suppress commands and discard the live instruction.
A watched physical and architectural index are arbitrary at every step, so the assertions check all indices rather than one fixed register.
mutation_policy: Only copied RTL under out/ is changed. DUT-local assertions are disabled in mutated copies to require detection by the independent ownership monitor; baseline DUT assertions remain enabled.
claim: Bounded smoke for the existing full-sized serialized rename module only; not induction, dual-lane ownership, ROB wrap, nested checkpoint recovery, or complete formal-readiness acceptance.
